findings.message: 'still' used adverbially for 'silently/covertly' is an unidiomatic collocation in German (primary meaning: motionless/quiet).
findings.evidence: flickt der Agent ihn nicht still, damit der Test gruen wird
findings.resolution: fixed: reworded to 'stillschweigend' (the precise German idiom for tacitly papering over)
